comment: Curated registry: companies and the brands they own in the Indian market. Listed companies get live shareholding from NSE quarterly filings via scripts/refresh.py; private ones use the static block. Aliases are matched after lowercasing and stripping non-alphanumerics.

companies.name: Hindustan Unilever Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (HINDUNILVR); quarterly shareholding filed publicly.

brands.notes: Wheel is HUL's mass-market detergent brand.
India's oldest detergent brand, launched 1959.
Founded by the Tatas in 1952, sold to HUL in 1996.
Kerala ayurvedic brand acquired by HUL in 2016.
Brooke Bond (Red Label, Taj Mahal, 3 Roses) sits in HUL's beverages portfolio.
Annapurna salt/atta is a legacy HUL brand; the line has been scaled down over the years.
Acquired from GSK in 2020.
Acquired from GSK in 2020.
Renamed from Fair & Lovely in 2020.

companies.name: Nestlé India Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (NESTLEIND); quarterly shareholding filed publicly.

promoter_override.label: Wadia Group promoters (via UK entity)
promoter_override.note: The promoter stake is held through UK-incorporated Associated Biscuits International but is controlled by the Indian Wadia group, so it is counted as Indian here. The exchange filing itself tags it as foreign.

companies.name: ITC Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (ITC). ITC has no promoter; British American Tobacco (UK) holds roughly a quarter as a public shareholder, which shows up in the foreign bucket.

brands.notes: One of India's oldest soap brands, made since 1918.

companies.name: Colgate-Palmolive (India) Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (COLPAL); quarterly shareholding filed publicly.

companies.name: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (PGHH). Many other P&G brands in India sit in the unlisted P&G Home Products arm.

brands.notes: Neem soap brand from 1920, acquired via Henkel India.
UK heritage tea brand owned by Tata since 2000.

companies.name: Varun Beverages Ltd
companies.company_notes: Indian-owned bottler and distributor for PepsiCo beverages; the brands themselves belong to PepsiCo (USA).

brands.notes: Bottles Pepsi, Mirinda, 7Up and Sting in India; brand ownership stays with PepsiCo (USA).

companies.name: Patanjali Foods Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (PATANJALI); formerly Ruchi Soya.

brands.notes: The packaged-foods business of the Patanjali group sits in this listed company.

companies.name: Titan Company Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (TITAN); joint promoters are Tata and the Tamil Nadu government's TIDCO.

companies.name: Timex Group India Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on BSE (TIMEX); this entry is curated from its latest BSE filing rather than refreshed weekly.
companies.company_notes: Foreign promoter holds close to the 75% regulatory ceiling.

companies.name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (TMPV) after the 2025 demerger; the commercial-vehicle arm (TMCV) is also Tata-promoted.

brands.notes: Also owns Jaguar Land Rover (UK) as a subsidiary.
Fully Indian since the Honda joint venture ended in 2011.
British-origin marque, Indian-owned since 1994.

companies.name: Whirlpool of India Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (WHIRLPOOL). Whirlpool Corp has been trimming its stake in recent years.

companies.name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (CROMPTON); no promoter, largely institution-owned.

brands.notes: Indian contract manufacturer that assembles phones, TVs and appliances for global brands.

companies.name: AWL Agri Business Ltd (formerly Adani Wilmar)
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (AWL). Promoter holding is split between Singapore's Wilmar and the Indian Adani group; the filing-based split below captures both sides.

brands.notes: The Indian franchise operator is Indian-owned; the Domino's brand itself belongs to Domino's Pizza Inc (USA).

companies.name: Page Industries Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (PAGEIND); exclusive Indian licensee of Jockey (USA).

brands.notes: Made and sold by Page Industries under license; the Jockey brand belongs to Jockey International (USA).
Indian-born brand; its maker is now controlled by Heineken.

companies.name: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd
companies.company_notes: Ahmedabad-based pharma major of the Torrent Group.

companies.name: Abbott India Ltd
companies.listing_note: Listed on NSE/BSE (ABBOTINDIA); its filings aren't exposed by the NSE API this registry uses, so this entry is curated.

companies.name: Parle Products Pvt Ltd
companies.company_notes: 100% Indian family-owned. Parle Agro (Frooti, Appy) is a separate Chauhan family company, also Indian.

brands.notes: An Italian name, but Indian-owned since 1969.

companies.name: Gujarat Co-operative Milk Marketing Federation (Amul)
companies.listing_note: Farmer-owned co-operative; not a company with shareholders in the usual sense.

companies.name: Mother Dairy Fruit & Vegetable Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Wholly owned by the NDDB, a Government of India statutory body.

companies.name: Haldiram Snacks Foods Pvt Ltd
companies.parent_company: Agarwal family, with minority global investors
companies.listing_note: Private; Temasek (Singapore) and IHC/Alpha Wave (UAE) bought minority stakes in 2025.

companies.name: PepsiCo India Holdings Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiary of a US-listed parent.
companies.company_notes: Beverages are bottled and distributed in India by the Indian-owned, listed Varun Beverages — but the brands belong to PepsiCo (USA).

brands.notes: Developed in India, but owned by PepsiCo (USA).
Delhi's Uncle Chipps was acquired by PepsiCo's Frito-Lay in 2000.
The Mumbai brand Duke's was acquired by PepsiCo in 1994; Mangola was later folded into the Slice line.

companies.name: Coca-Cola India Pvt Ltd / Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian arms of a US-listed parent.

brands.notes: Born Indian (Parle) in 1977, sold to Coca-Cola in 1993.
Born Indian (Parle), sold to Coca-Cola in 1993.
Born Indian (Parle), sold to Coca-Cola in 1993.

companies.name: Mondelez India Foods Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiary of a US-listed parent (formerly Cadbury India).

companies.name: Mars International India Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiary of the private US Mars family company.

companies.name: Ferrero India Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiary of the private Ferrero family group.

companies.name: Orkla India (MTR Foods & Eastern)
companies.listing_note: Controlled by Norway's Orkla; MTR was Bengaluru family-owned until 2007.

brands.notes: The Mavalli Tiffin Rooms packaged-food business was sold to Orkla (Norway) in 2007.

companies.name: Reckitt Benckiser (India) Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiary of a UK-listed parent.

companies.name: Johnson & Johnson / Kenvue India
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiaries of US-listed parents; consumer brands moved to Kenvue in 2023.

companies.name: Procter & Gamble Home Products Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: The unlisted P&G arm that sells detergents, shampoo and diapers in India.

companies.name: Himalaya Wellness Company
companies.parent_company: Manal family via Himalaya Global Holdings
companies.listing_note: Private; the group holding company is domiciled overseas (Dubai/Cayman) though the business and founding family are Indian.
companies.company_notes: Counted Indian by family control, but note the holding company itself is domiciled outside India.

companies.name: GD Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Private Kolkata company, maker of Boroline since 1929.

brands.notes: A swadeshi-era brand, launched in 1929 as an Indian alternative to imported creams.

companies.name: Nirma Ltd
companies.listing_note: Delisted in 2012; now private under the Patel family.

companies.name: Wipro Enterprises Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: The private (non-IT) Wipro arm that owns consumer care brands.

companies.name: Patanjali Ayurved Ltd
companies.listing_note: Private; Acharya Balkrishna holds the overwhelming majority.

brands.notes: Packaged foods sit in the separately listed Patanjali Foods Ltd.
Made by a Karnataka state enterprise since 1916.

companies.name: Shri Mahila Griha Udyog Lijjat Papad
companies.listing_note: A women's co-operative, owned by its working members.

companies.name: Amway India Enterprises Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiary of the private US direct-selling company.

companies.name: LG Electronics India
companies.listing_note: Majority-held by LG Electronics (Korea); a minority stake was listed in India recently.

companies.name: Samsung India Electronics Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiary of the Korean parent.

companies.name: Xiaomi India
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiary of the Chinese parent.

companies.name: Apple India Pvt Ltd
companies.listing_note: Wholly-owned Indian subsidiary of a US-listed parent.

brands.notes: Many iPhones are assembled in India, but the brand and profits are American.

companies.name: Imagine Marketing Ltd (boAt)
companies.parent_company: Aman Gupta & Sameer Mehta, with VC investors
companies.listing_note: Private Indian company with venture investors including Warburg Pincus (USA).

companies.name: Velvette International Pharma Products
companies.listing_note: Private Chennai company; no public shareholding filings.
companies.company_notes: Pioneer of the shampoo sachet in the 1980s; today a small regional player.

companies.name: VI-John Group
companies.listing_note: Private company; no public shareholding filings.
companies.company_notes: Delhi-based personal care group best known for shaving creams.

companies.name: Pilot (Indian private footwear maker)
companies.listing_note: Small private brand; no public filings.

companies.name: Nice (regional Indian ice cream makers)
companies.listing_note: No single national owner; 'Nice' is used by several regional dairies.

brands.notes: Several regional dairies use this name; ownership varies by city.

companies.name: Wakefield (legacy grocery brand)
companies.listing_note: No reliable current filing found for this legacy brand.
companies.company_notes: A heritage custard/baking brand whose ownership trail is unclear.
